text: 欢迎回到我的课堂今天我们将开始写书的部分请准备好学生的书本和工作室我们将写一些关于另一个女孩Megan的生活的东西与一些照片的帮助假设你是Megan的朋友你将写一篇关于她的短文在国际的孩子报纸上文章的意思是一篇写书首先,请看看写书的文章《Megan的一天》你认为这些文章含有关关键的信息吗?是的,日是一个关键的文章当我们写一天关于某人的生活我们应该在简单的现场词中描述他或她的日常活动另一个关键的文章是Megan所以,这篇文章是关于Megan的一天我们可以在简单的现场词中描述Megan的活动你想知道什么?你可能想问这些问题她是什么样的?她是什么样的一个人?她的生活是怎么一天的?你看,这是Megan其实,Megan是一个15岁的Badminton冠军这里,15岁的意思是比15岁更年轻这意味着Megan是一个像你这样的中学生她把所有其他球员都打赢了在Badminton比赛所以,她是一个冠军冠军你知道任何冠军是什么吗?你知道任何冠军是什么吗?什么是冠军让你想象的?我肯定世界冠军让你想象很多东西例如,一位冠军是强壮和合适的,必须擅长运动他或她每天都做很多训练他或她生活着健康和正常的生活他或者她在比赛中获奖赛等等非常好的思想让我们看看Megan的一些照片,知道更多的她请看看照片,并考虑这个问题这些照片是什么?They are about a day in Megan's life.Please look at them again.What else can you find?There are different times, adverbs, and adverbial phrases of frequency in each picture.Good finding.Look at these four times, and we can tell that the pictures are in time order.So, how many parts can we divide pictures into?Yes, we can group them into three parts.They are before school, at school, and after school.Picture 1 and 2 belong to the first part, before school.Picture 3 and 4 go to the second part, at school.And picture 5 to 10 should be in the third part, after school.Look, this is the introduction.Megan is the under-15 badminton champion in our city.She lives a healthy life.What is the key information in the introduction?Under-15, champion, and healthy.These three key words tell us Megan's identity and lifestyle.We can use three parallel paragraphs to describe Megan's daily routines.Before school, at school, and after school.They include her morning activities, school life, and after school activities.The three paragraphs are parallel and provide details and examples.They support big ideas in the introduction.As an under-15 champion, how does Megan live a healthy life?Let's move on.Let's focus on each paragraph and find out the daily activities Megan does.What does Megan do before school?What can we learn from these two pictures?Megan gets up at 6 a.Megan goes jogging every morning.What about her school life?What can we know from the pictures?Megan goes to school on foot at 7.She achieves B grades in most subjects.Her best subject is P.What does she do after school?Megan walks home at 4.She plays basketball on Mondays and Thursdays.She plays badminton on Tuesdays and Wednesdays.She goes to sunny sports center twice a week.What kind of food does she eat?She always eats healthy food.She seldom eats sweet food.She never eats fried food.When does she go to bed?She goes to bed at 10 p.Now, let's try to describe the pictures more vividly and make the writing better.In paragraph 1, we know Megan gets up at 6 a.She goes jogging every morning.Here, we have two adverbial phrases of frequency.Do you remember where we can put the adverbial phrases of frequency?Yes, we can put them at the beginning or at the end of a sentence.In this way, the sentence beginnings are varied.So, it goes like this., Megan gets up.Vary sentence beginnings.Why does Megan get up so early?She gets up so early in order to do exercise.We can combine sentences by adding conjunctions.She goes jogging every morning, so she gets up early at 6 a.Combine sentences by adding conjunctions.Then, why does she go jogging?Don't forget big idea in the introduction.We need to make the paragraphs related to the introduction.Megan is a champion and she lives a healthy life.So, we can revise paragraph 1 like this.Megan goes jogging every morning, so she gets up early at 6 a.As a sports girl, she has to exercise a lot to keep fit.Relate paragraphs to the introduction.These are three tips for us to revise our writing to make it better.This time, please try to revise paragraph 2 with the help of the checklist.Ready?Let's go.Have you finished?Let's share.Let's read one of my students' revision of paragraph 2.How does she vary sentence beginnings?She puts at 7.at the beginning of the sentence.Does she combine simple sentences into a compound sentence?Yes, she uses and to combine, she achieves b in most subjects.And her best subject is pe into one sentence.She achieves a in pe and b in the rest of the subjects.Does she relate the paragraph to the introduction?Yes, this paragraph mainly talks about how Megan does as a student.Maybe your revision is different from hers.That doesn't matter.I'm sure you did well too.This time, the task is a little bit tricky.The third paragraph covers all the activities Megan does after school.You can revise it based on the checklist.The fourth paragraph covers all the activities Megan does after school.The fifth paragraph covers all the activities Megan does after school.你完成了吗?我相信你应该做了一个很棒的工作。我想分享另一位学生的课程。让我们看看他做了什么改善。你做了什么改善?他怎么改善课程的开始?他改变了星期二和星期一的课程,把课程放在课程的开始。他把简单的课程放在一本简单的课程里吗?是的,他用了一个在后期开始时的课程,告诉我们梅根去学校后做什么。他把课程关于介绍的吗?是的,既然梅根是冠军,她做了很多运动去保持健康,准备接下来的比赛。她也去了星期二的训练中心做运动。在做运动和有好的饮食习惯中,梅根生活着健康的生活。看,这里我们有一个简短的文章关于梅根的生活。我们在这里有什么错误?我们可以在时间纪录中提供时间纪录。什么可以在文章中提供时间纪录?正确,冠军是最好的选择。所以这是梅根生活中的一天。她平衡工作和玩游戏,没想到她变成冠军。当我们写一天在某人的生活中,我们应该用简单的现代词来描述他的或她的日常活动。我们可以在时间纪录中提供连续的描述,以支持冠军的想象。当写,试图改变词词的开始,在不同的地方提供述词。冠军可以帮助写写词更有道理。今天的家务。这就是今天的课程结束。
